cases.title: Departure from Paris
cases.intro: The Midnight Express has barely left the Gare de l'Est when a scream rings out. Mr. Fenwick lies still, and you are the only detective aboard. Sir Sterling, the British diplomat, keeps one hand on a locked dispatch box.
cases.outro: Mr. Sutton is locked in the baggage car until the next station.

steps.text: Your first case. Every row and every column holds exactly one person, the victim included. Start with the victim: Mr. Fenwick was sitting on a suitcase, and there is only one suitcase on the board (row 2, column 1). Tap F below, then tap the suitcase itself.

Mr. Fenwick now owns row 2 and column 1, so nobody else can use them (they are shaded). Mr. Sutton was on the Platform, room 1 at the top left. Only one Platform cell is still free. Tap S, then tap that cell.
Mr. Lambert was sitting in a seat. There are five seats, but rows 1 and 2 and column 2 are already taken, which rules out four of them. Tap L, then tap the one seat left.
Mrs. Marsh was in the Lounge Car (room 3). Rows 1, 2 and 4 are taken, so that leaves row 3, in the only column nobody has yet. Tap M and place Mrs. Marsh there.

tutorial.accuse: Everyone is in place. The murderer is the only person who was alone with the victim. Mr. Fenwick is on the Platform with just one other person. Tap Accuse and name them.
